mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 2.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 2.5% (t-test of mean return < 0, p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate rise exceeding 0.3 percentage points (UNRATE > 5.3%) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.3% (t-test of mean return > 0, p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) below their 6-month moving averages signals broad economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST are below 6-month moving averages (t-test of mean return > 0, p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In recessionary regimes (UNRATE > 5.0% and GDPC1 growth < 0.5% annualized), a decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below its 3-month average triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS < 3mo_MA and in recessionary regime (t-test of mean return > 0, p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Monthly real personal consumption growth exceeding 0.5% (RSAFS growth rate > 0.5%) signals robust consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS growth rate > 0.5% (t-test of mean return < 0, p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS below 2.5% and CPIAUCSL below 215 indicates coordinated monetary easing, reducing equity risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5% and CPIAUCSL < 215 (t-test of mean return < 0, p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained real personal consumption above 380,000 million dollars (RSAFS > 380,000) indicates strong consumer demand that supports corporate profitability, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 380,000 (t-test of mean return < 0, p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 110.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0 (t-test of mean return > 0, p < 0.05).
